item.title: Boy, 15, shot in South Deering
item.description: <p>A teenage boy is recovering after being shot in the face in the South Deering neighborhood early Saturday.</p><p>The boy, 15, was outside in the 10000 block of South Paxton Avenue when a vehicle drove past and someone inside fired shots around 3:30 a.m., according to Chicago police. </p><p>The boy was taken to Comer Children's Hospital in fair condition with a gunshot wound to the left side of the face.</p><p>No one is in custody and detectives are investigating.</p>

item.title: Boy, 17, shot to death in Logan Square
item.description: <p>A teenage boy was shot and killed in Logan Square on Saturday afternoon.</p><p></p><p>The boy, 17, was in the bedroom of a home in the 1900 block of N. St. Louis Ave. about 1:27 p.m. when he was shot in the head by an unknown offender, Chicago police said.</p><p></p><p>The boy was taken to Mount Sinai Hospital, where he was pronounced dead.</p><p></p><p>No one is in custody. Detectives are investigating.</p>

item.title: Shedd Aquarium’s anti-Valentine’s Day event allows cynics, singles to de-stress in nature
item.description: <p>There are those who spend Valentine’s Day wining and dining, and then there are those who spend it raging.</p><p>A Shedd Aquarium event at LaGrange Park Woods on Saturday catered to the latter group. About 15 participants burned off steam by snapping, sawing and burning buckthorn, an invasive tree threatening native plants and wildlife in the area.</p><p>Ten-year-old Gideon Majka-Lauterbach grunted as he sliced through thick trunks and hauled large armfuls of the wood to a crackling pyre.</p>
